children: Robinhood ecosystem meme coin microduck briefly surpassed a $13 million market cap and was trading at $12.71 million, up more than 352% on the day. According to ChainCatcher, the token’s narrative centers on the open-source AI robot Microduck, which originated from the Open Duck Mini community project and was productized with support from Hugging Face.

Microduck is priced at $399 and comes with a camera and LiDAR. It supports an open-source SDK and training tools, can learn different actions through reinforcement learning, and is positioned as a low-cost, customizable AI pet concept. Community participants also describe it as combining physical AI, open-source robotics, and animal-themed meme narratives.

title: Robinhood Ecosystem Meme Coin Microduck Tops $13 Million Market Cap
